description: Demolition of existing rear outbuilding, erection of single storey rear outbuilding to be used as ancillary space by the occupants of the ground floor flat, external alterations to include changes to fenestration, landscaping to include increasing the size of existing front lightwell.
subdivision_of_building: Flat A (ground and first floor) and front and rear garden
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan (where applicable) of at least one suitable sustainable drainage system (i.e. water butt with overflow, rain garden, bioretention planter box, living roof (substrate depth of 80-150mm excluding the vegetative mat), permeable paving etc.) shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA. If soakaways i.e. plastic modules and soakaway rings are used, an infiltration test must be carried out to ensure that the capacity of the soil is suitable for infiltration. It must be demonstrated that there will be no increase in surface water flow being discharged offsite and an overall reduction in peak flow rate and volume.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;"><br></span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">REASON: In the interest of providing sustainable drainage system</span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5b6412ff-7fff-9fa8-8eb4-dfc204b99d2c"></span></p><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">A scheme for the provision and implementation of flood resilient and resistant construction details and measures for the lightwell against surface water flood risk shall be submitted to and agreed, in writing with the LPA in consultation with the LLFA prior to the construction of the measures. Mitigation measures may include providing suitable drainage, threshold levels and sump pump where required in the lightwell.&nbsp;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;"><br></span></div><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">REASON: In the interest of providing sustainable drainage system </span></div>

The measures set out in the Tree Protection Plan shall remain in place until the completion of the construction. Furthermore, new surfaces within the Root Protection Areas (RPAs) of retained trees, including the pedestrian path, must be constructed with a cellular confinement system using a no-dig method as specified in BS5837(2012): Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction.
